catalyst_text: Announced positive topline Phase 3 maintenance results
detailed_catalyst_text: Positive topline data from the 44-week Phase 3 ABTECT maintenance trial in adults with moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis showed both 25 mg and 50 mg doses met the primary endpoint of clinical remission and all key secondary endpoints. Clinical remission occurred in about 51% on treatment versus 10% on placebo, and safety was favorable with no new signals. These results support the potential of a once-daily oral maintenance therapy.
catalyst_text_evidence: PARIS, France – 2026-06-01 – 10:05 pm CEST – Abivax SA (PARIS:FR, NASDAQ:ABVX) ("Abivax" or the "Company"), ... today announced positive topline results from the Phase 3 ABTECT maintenance trial evaluating obefazimod, its investigational oral, first-in-class miR-124 enhancer, in adults with moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis ("UC"). The results demonstrate that both the 25 mg and 50 mg doses of obefazimod met the primary endpoint of clinical remission and all key secondary endpoints at Week 44. Obefazimod demonstrated a favorable safety profile over the 44-week maintenance trial (N=580), with no new safety signals.

catalyst_text: Presented rapid symptomatic improvements and favorable safety profile
detailed_catalyst_text: New clinical analyses from the Phase 3 ABTECT-1 and ABTECT-2 induction trials in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis were presented, showing early symptomatic response by week 1 and symptomatic remission by week 2 with safety comparable to placebo. A pooled safety analysis reported similar rates of serious TEAEs and discontinuations versus placebo, and biomarker data showed miR-124 upregulation with reductions in IL-17A and IL-6. These findings support rapid efficacy onset, tolerability, and the proposed mechanism of action in ulcerative colitis.
catalyst_text_evidence: "A pooled analysis of safety data from ABTECT-1 and ABTECT-2 induction trials demonstrates a favorable safety profile with rates of serious treatment emergent adverse events and study discontinuation similar to placebo" "Symptomatic response of obefazimod was observed as early as week 1 (first time point evaluated) with symptomatic remission observed at week 2 (nominally significant p-value <0.05) in a pooled analysis of ABTECT-1 and ABTECT-2" "Biomarker data from ABTECT-1 and ABTECT-2 induction trials indicate upregulation of miR-124 and reduction of key inflammatory cytokines (IL-17A and IL-6) toward homeostatic levels"

catalyst_text: Reported positive preclinical anti fibrotic activity in models
detailed_catalyst_text: New preclinical data presented showed anti-fibrotic activity in inflammatory bowel disease models, with significant reductions in fibrosis biomarkers and fibroblast activation markers. Dual anti-inflammatory and anti-fibrotic effects were observed in both an in vitro human fibroblast system and an in vivo animal model. These results suggest potential to address fibrosis, a key unmet need particularly relevant to Crohn’s disease.
catalyst_text_evidence: "Anti-fibrotic effects of obefazimod were observed in both a preclinical human fibroblast model and in an in vivo animal model, suggesting potential to address a major unmet need in Crohn's disease" "In an in vitro human fibroblast model, obefazimod led to a ~50% reduction in a biomarker of active fibrosis (Pro-C3) (p < 0.0001) and a ~30% reduction in a fibroblast activation marker (⍺SMA) (p < 0.0001)" "In an in vivo animal model, obefazimod exhibited dual anti-inflammatory and anti-fibrotic effects leading to rapid improvement in markers of disease activity"
